info.name: RapidRatings API (Sandbox)
info.description:
# RapidRatings API: Sandbox

Data Integrations project, integration #1. Every request was verified live against the sandbox on **2026-10-28**. Saved example responses are real (trimmed) unless marked *from OpenAPI spec*.

## Setup
1. Import this collection and **RapidRatings-Sandbox.postman_environment.json**.
2. Select the environment and fill in `client_id` and `client_secret` (from the project `.env`: `RR_CLIENT_ID`, `RR_CLIENT_SECRET`).
3. Send any request. The collection pre-request script fetches and caches the token automatically (or run **Auth › Get Access Token** first).

## Authentication
OAuth 2.0 **client credentials**. `POST {{token_url}}` with HTTP Basic `client_id:client_secret` and body `grant_type=client_credentials` returns `{access_token, token_type: "Bearer", expires_in: 1800, scope}`. **No refresh token**: request a new token after 30 minutes. All other requests use `Authorization: Bearer {{access_token}}` (inherited from the collection). The same token works on both hosts.

## Hosts
| Variable | Host | APIs |
|---|---|---|
| `{{data_api_url}}` | rridata.sandbox.rrilabs.co/v2.0 | token, companies, portfolios, periods, ratings |
| `{{outreach_api_url}}` | api.sandbox.rrilabs.co | outreach requests |

## Behaviour (verified)
| | rridata | outreach |
|---|---|---|
| Paging | `page` + `next` URL; companies 20, periods/ratings 10 per page (fixed) | `limit` + `cursor` (`next_cursor`) |
| Page past end | companies 404, portfolios/periods/ratings **500** | n/a |
| Unknown query param | 400 | 400 |
| Invalid/expired token | **403** `Not Authorized.` | **401** |
| Error body | `{"Request": {"message", "info"}}` | RFC 7807 `{type,title,status,detail}` |
| Trailing slash | **required** | optional |

⚠️ **Outreach › Create Outreach Request sends real emails** to the counterparty contact. Don't run it casually.

exec: // Auto-auth: obtains a client-credentials token when missing or within 60s of expiry.
// Tokens last 1800s and RapidRatings issues no refresh token, so renewal = a new token request.
if (!id || !secret) { console.warn('Set client_id and client_secret in the environment.'); return; }
if (err || res.code !== 200) { console.error('Token request failed', err || res.code); return; }

variable.description: Set automatically by the pre-request script / Get Access Token

request.description:
Obtains a Bearer token. **Client auth:** HTTP Basic `base64(client_id:client_secret)`. **Body:** `grant_type=client_credentials` (form-urlencoded; JSON is also accepted).

| Field | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| access_token | string | Use as `Authorization: Bearer <token>` |
| expires_in | integer | Seconds (1800 = 30 min) |
| token_type | string | `Bearer` |
| scope | string | `uid introspection openid` |

Errors: 401 bad credentials **or missing grant_type**; 400 unsupported grant_type; 405 GET instead of POST.

item.name: 7. Outreach (write) ⚠️ sends real emails
item.description: **Creating an outreach request makes RapidRatings email the counterparty contact.** Only send real, approved requests. Never include this folder in automated runs.

request.description:
⚠️ **Sends real emails.**

| Field | Required | Rules |
|---|---|---|
| counterparty.company_name | yes | 1–255 chars |
| counterparty.contact.first_name / last_name | yes | 1–255 chars |
| counterparty.contact.email | yes | email |
| counterparty.contact.country | yes | ISO-3166 alpha-3 |
| counterparty.contact.tel | no | |
| counterparty.reference_id | no | your supplier ID |
| counterparty.additional_contacts | no | max 1; 409 if org not on Intercom delivery |
| relationship_manager.name / email | yes | 1–255 chars |

Returns **201 Created** with the outreach request object.
